lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Anterior region shows large, sparse, high-luminance circular spots arranged in loose vertical columns. Mid-to-posterior regions exhibit a transition to smaller, more densely packed spots forming tighter vertical and horizontal alignments.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible across the mid-flank, intersecting with horizontal spot rows to create a defined rectilinear grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent linear feature is visible running horizontally along the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and deep shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high spatial density of small, high-luminance blobs concentrated along the leading edge and distal tip, contrasting with the larger spot size on the primary flank.
